title: Germany Brief — Wed Oct 28
description: Good morning, and welcome to your Germany Brief for Wednesday, October twenty-eighth. title: Egypt Brief — Wed Oct 28
description: Good morning, and welcome to your Egypt Brief for Wednesday, October twenty eighth. We're looking back at everything since Sunday, and ahead to next Sunday, November first. Three big stories today: parliament has authorized military support for Saudi Arabia, the pound has hit a record low past fifty six to the dollar, and the Central Bank sets interest rates tomorrow. title: My Brief Markets: Wednesday, October 28
description: Good morning, and welcome to your global markets brief. Wall Street rose on Tuesday. The S and P five hundred gained about point six percent to close near seventy-seven hundred and twenty-three, and the Nasdaq jumped more than one percent, led by chip makers. title: My Brief Germany: Wednesday, October 28
description: Good morning, and welcome to your Germany brief. the coalition is under pressure. A minister from the junior partner resigned this month, Chancellor Merz's approval ratings are weak, and the far-right AfD keeps gaining after strong results in the September regional elections. title: My Brief Egypt: Wednesday, October 28
description: Good morning, and welcome to your Egypt brief. The pound has hit a fresh record low. On Monday it weakened past fifty-six to the dollar for the first time, after touching about fifty-five on Thursday last week. title: My Brief Bayern: Wednesday, October 28
description: Good morning, and welcome to your Bayern brief. On Sunday they won three-one away at Freiburg, with goals from Upamecano, Gnabry, and Olise, plus an own goal from Freiburg. That put them back on top of the Bundesliga, after Dortmund had briefly taken the lead. The bigger story is off the pitch. title: Test episode: your new voice
description: Good morning, and welcome to your Sunday brief. This is a quick test, so you can hear how I sound before we switch the real briefs over. Bayern had a solid week, markets were a little nervous, and back home in Cairo the weather is finally cooling down. If this sounds like you, we're in business. If not, tell me what feels off, and I'll tune it.
